tagline: Repair well. Reuse more. Waste less.
hero: One practical front door for repairs, reclaimed materials, trade-ins, pickups, and safe next steps.

request.title: What can we help with?
request.description: Describe the item, project, trade-in, or reclaimed material you need.

condition.title: Current condition
condition.description: Share symptoms, damage, measurements, quantity, or known safety concerns.

location.title: Pickup or service area
location.description: Provide your neighborhood or postal code and whether pickup is needed.

timing.title: Preferred timing
timing.description: Tell us your ideal date or any deadline.

welcome.message: Tell us what you are repairing, finding, trading, or moving. If there is smoke, heat, sparking, a melted plug, leaking fuel, or another immediate hazard, stop using the item and say so first.
